remarks: Discover this delightful two-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bath antique farmhouse in North Stamford. Nestled on a flat .39-acre lot, this charming property boasts a rustic barn with garage parking and ample storage, as well as an enchanting antique schoolhouse that adds to its rich historical character. Meticulously maintained and full of unique details, this welcoming home offers the perfect blend of rustic charm and modern comfort. Don't miss the chance to make this enchanting property your new home! **House being sold in AS IS condition**
